origin: Local derived periorbital crop subset generated from authorized Monk Skin Tone Examples (MST-E) source images. MST-E was released with the skin-tone annotation/fairness work and contains images/videos spanning the Monk Skin Tone scale.
permission_access: Obtain MST-E source material through the official release associated with the MST-E/Monk Skin Tone Examples work and follow its terms. Generate periorbital crops locally using scripts/crop_periorbital_images.py. Do not distribute source or cropped images unless the MST-E terms and any subject/image permissions allow redistribution.
access_instructions: Obtain MST-E source material through the official release associated with the MST-E/Monk Skin Tone Examples work and follow its terms. repo_policy: No source or cropped MST-E images are stored. Cropped outputs are local-only and gitignored.
